summary: 1931 L-4 ground cab on the Fremont National Forest, vandalized by the 1990s then remodeled into a Recreation.gov rental.

access.note: Available to rent via Recreation.gov; combination lock, code from Paisley Ranger District.

visit.trail_note: Reached via Forest Road from the Paisley District Office; Bald Butte Trail nearby.

events.note: Built as an L-4 ground cab.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register March 1, 1998.
Suffered vandalism into the 1990s before being remodeled.
Remodeled and placed on the Recreation Rental program around the 1990s.

evidence.quote: Constructed in 1931, this ground-mounted gable-roofed L-4 cab suffered from vandalism into the 1990's when it was remodeled and placed on the Recreation Rental program.

evidence.supports: Vandalized by the 1990s, then remodeled into the rental program
evidence.quote: suffered from vandalism into the 1990's when it was remodeled and placed on the Recreation Rental program

evidence.supports: Rental facilities: two cots, propane heater, stove, lighting, no water, accessible vault toilet
evidence.quote: The 14' x 14' lookout is furnished with two cots, a table, bench and storage cabinets. It is also equipped with a propane heater, cook stove, and lights.
There is no water on-site, so guests must bring sufficient supplies for drinking, cooking and washing.

evidence.supports: Combination lock, code from Paisley Ranger District
evidence.quote: Entry to the cabin is by combination lock. The lock combination will be provided in your reservation confirmation letter. Please stop by or call the Paisley Ranger District (541) 943-3114 to pick up the lock combination.

evidence.supports: Nearby Bald Butte Trail and Gearhart Mountain Wilderness access, stargazing
evidence.quote: Bald Butte Trail is a quiet all-season trail that offers a variety of terrain and wildlife viewing opportunities.

notes_for_editor: No staffing dates or named lookouts found; built year (1931) is consistent across NHLR and firelookout.com. No contradictory info encountered for this tower.
